findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Missing, unavailable or failed snapshot data can be displayed as measured zero.
findings.plan_claim: Unsupported/unknown never becomes real zero; UI has distinct loading, empty, partial, stale and error states.
findings.contract_claim: Funnel UI forbids fake zero and requires support-aware presentation.
findings.runtime_fact: dashboard.html starts with zero KPIs, builds an all-zero snapshot when snapshot is null, and preserves existing zeros on auth/HTTP/payload/exception exits.
findings.schema_fact: Not applicable; this is presentation behavior.
findings.live_evidence: The public /dashboard route serves dashboard.html. Production reachability and current user traffic were not independently measured.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Absence/error is materially represented as measured zero.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not trigger provider writes or alter production UI during audit.
findings.remediation_dependency: Truthful state adapter before E11/E12 cutover.
findings.acceptance_needed: Loading, empty, error, partial and stale fixtures never render numeric zero unless the provider fact is supported zero.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Revenue can be mislabeled or duplicated as profit/margin across Formula/API/UI.
findings.plan_claim: Canonical derived names are revenue and revenue_margin; profit/margin are versioned compatibility aliases only.
findings.contract_claim: Ad Analysis removes margin and exposes Revenue.
findings.runtime_fact: Formula Engine and its tests return profit and margin as primary fields; revenue/revenue_margin are absent.
findings.schema_fact: Derived metrics are correctly not stored in Dataset V2.
findings.live_evidence: Local Phase 1 tests pass the old naming expectations.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Correct arithmetic is exposed under superseded business names.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not silently rename without versioning/golden parity.
findings.acceptance_needed: Canonical revenue/revenue_margin outputs, explicit alias policy and end-to-end parity.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: UI cannot distinguish unsupported, unknown, empty and zero-denominator null results.
findings.plan_claim: Support propagates and previous/denominator zero is explicitly not comparable.
findings.contract_claim: Unsupported bucket and new/not-comparable bucket are distinct.
findings.runtime_fact: Derived values return number or null without derived support/null_reason; Query meta only carries additive support.
findings.schema_fact: Raw metric support exists, but derived result semantics are not persisted or returned.
findings.live_evidence: Tests assert null but not a reason contract.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Null preserves numerical safety but loses the business meaning required for presentation.
findings.safe_boundary: UI must not infer the reason from null alone.
findings.acceptance_needed: Every derived value carries support and null_reason through Formula, API, Compare, Export and UI.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Unreconciled or stale facts can be presented without freshness/finality warning.
findings.plan_claim: E11 returns freshness, partial and warnings metadata; E12 renders them.
findings.contract_claim: Current/final claims require provenance and reconciliation evidence.
findings.runtime_fact: Workspace query meta lacks data-through, observed-at, source job, provisional/final, partial/stale and warning fields.
findings.schema_fact: A2 found live rows with null source_job_id and no finality state.
findings.live_evidence: No Funnel API route exists yet; risk becomes P0 if a UI presents these results as current/final.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: The internal query output cannot carry A2 data maturity truth to a UI.
findings.safe_boundary: Keep E11 blocked until provenance/freshness contract exists.
findings.acceptance_needed: Stale/provisional/reconciled/final fixtures produce exact API and UI states.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Compare or growth ranking may be reimplemented in UI and mishandle previous zero.
findings.plan_claim: Backend Compare uses (current-previous)/abs(previous)*100; previous zero returns null.
findings.contract_claim: Funnel and Ad Analysis compare/ranking are backend-computed.
findings.runtime_fact: Current Query Service is single-period; no versioned Compare Engine or compare output was found.
findings.live_evidence: UI freeze contracts include comparison columns and percent-change ranking, but no runtime parity evidence exists.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Frozen UI depends on a backend capability that is absent.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not implement compare math in frontend.
findings.acceptance_needed: Versioned current/previous/absolute/percent output with zero-denominator and period-length fixtures.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: An internal service could be reused as an HTTP boundary without verified tenant/account authority or query budgets.
findings.plan_claim: Shopify session resolves workspace/account server-side; caller query identity is forbidden; bounds/pagination apply.
findings.runtime_fact: WorkspaceFunnelQueryService accepts workspace_id, platform_account_id and scope parameters and only checks returned rows; no HTTP auth wrapper, max range or pagination exists.
findings.live_evidence: No /api/funnel/data route was found, so this is not currently an exposed endpoint finding.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Internal query logic is not the planned E11 API boundary.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not wire it directly to a route.
findings.acceptance_needed: Verified session-derived tenant/account, caller-claim rejection, bounds, pagination, load and IDOR tests.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Parked Organic/internal scope can leak into the first Shopify product as a Paid/Organic/Blend selector.
findings.plan_claim: Shopify Funnel API does not produce Paid, Organic or Blend UI segments.
findings.contract_claim: Parked Organic is not rendered as frontend hierarchy/filter.
findings.runtime_fact: Generic Query Service accepts and returns paid, organic and blend analysis_scope.
findings.schema_fact: Organic capability remains in canonical model by design.
findings.live_evidence: No Shopify Funnel API adapter exists yet.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Generic backend capability requires a Shopify-specific response boundary.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not delete generic capability; prevent UI exposure.
findings.acceptance_needed: Negative contract tests prove Organic/Blend scope cannot appear in first-slice Shopify response.
